2608.07368.title: Measurements Automatically Extracted from Zero Echo Time MRI Using Deep Learning Image Segmentation and Geometric Modeling Agree with Expert Manual Readings
2608.07368.paper_summary: Computed tomography (CT) remains the reference for 3D osseous morphometry in femoroacetabular impingement (FAI) but requires ionizing radiation and manual measurement. Zero echo time (ZTE) MRI visualizes cortical bone and yields FAI angles that agree with CT, but automated angle extraction remains limited. We developed and validated automated FAI angle computation from ZTE MRI and assessed agreement with expert manual measurements in a cross-sectional study (level of evidence, 3). Pelvic ZTE MRI was acquired in 73 participants (mean age 36.8 +/- 18.5 years; 51 women, 22 men), yielding 135 hips. nnU-Net was trained on 100 manually curated hips to segment the femur, pelvis, and three osseous landmarks. Custom geometric algorithms computed alpha, femoral neck-shaft, Tonnis, coronal and sagittal center-edge, and acetabular version angles from inferred segmentations. Measurements on 35 test hips were compared with the mean of two radiologists' manual measures using intraclass correlation (ICC) and Bland-Altman analysis. Dice exceeded 0.96 for bone and ranged from 0.65 to 0.83 for landmarks. Median landmark error was 0.38 mm (femoral head), 0.82 mm (lateral acetabulum), and <2.5 mm (medial acetabulum, greater trochanter). Interrater ICC was excellent for acetabular version, coronal center-edge, and Tonnis (>=0.82) but poor for alpha and femoral neck-shaft. Model versus rater-mean agreement was excellent for acetabular version, coronal center-edge, and Tonnis (0.92-0.96), good for mid-acetabular sagittal center-edge (0.74), and fair for alpha (0.45) and femoral neck-shaft (0.55). Model Bland-Altman limits of agreement were narrower than interrater limits for most angles. Fully automated morphometric assessment from ZTE MRI is feasible and performs comparably to expert readers for most coverage and version angles.
2608.07368.paper_summary_zh: 計算機斷層掃描 (CT) 仍然是股骨髖臼撞擊症 (FAI) 中三維骨骼形態測量的參考標準，但需要電離輻射和手動測量。零回聲時間 (ZTE) 磁共振成像 (MRI) 可視化皮質骨，並產生與 CT 一致的 FAI 角度，但自動角度提取仍然有限。我們開發並驗證了基於 ZTE MRI 的自動 FAI 角度計算，並在一項橫斷面研究中評估了與專家手動測量的協議（證據等級 3）。在 73 名參與者中獲得了骨盆 ZTE MRI（平均年齡 36.8 +/- 18.5 歲；51 名女性，22 名男性），共產生 135 個髖關節。nnU-Net 在 100 個手動策劃的髖關節上進行訓練，以分割股骨、骨盆和三個骨骼標誌。自定義幾何算法從推斷的分割中計算 alpha、股骨頸-幹、Tonnis、冠狀和矢狀中心邊緣以及髖臼版本角度。對 35 個測試髖關節的測量與兩位放射科醫生的手動測量均值進行了比較，使用了組內相關性 (ICC) 和 Bland-Altman 分析。骨骼的 Dice 超過 0.96，標誌的範圍為 0.65 到 0.83。中位數標誌誤差為 0.38 毫米（股骨頭）、0.82 毫米（外側髖臼）和 <2.5 毫米（內側髖臼、大轉子）。對於髖臼版本、冠狀中心邊緣和 Tonnis 的評估者間 ICC 優秀（>=0.82），但對於 alpha 和股骨頸-幹則較差。模型與評估者均值的協議對於髖臼版本、冠狀中心邊緣和 Tonnis 優秀（0.92-0.96），對於中髖臼矢狀中心邊緣良好（0.74），對於 alpha（0.45）和股骨頸-幹（0.55）則一般。模型的 Bland-Altman 協議限度比大多數角度的評估者間限度更窄。基於 ZTE MRI 的完全自動化形態測量評估是可行的，並且在大多數覆蓋和版本角度上表現與專家讀者相當。
